TABLE SETUP — walk to any corner pocket and tap its inside cushion corner (1 of 2)
Now walk to the DIAGONALLY OPPOSITE corner pocket and tap its cushion corner (2 of 2)

Looking for balls… make sure balls are on the table and in view

That\'s the white ball — tap the ball you want to pot instead
Ball selected ✓ — now tap the target pocket
Ball ✓ pocket ✓ — press 🎯 Create shot
Pick a ball and a pocket first
Can\'t see the white ball — make sure it\'s in view
